articles.title: What Double Chance means in SportyBet (1X, X2 and 12)
articles.notice: BetGaffer isn't affiliated with or endorsed by SportyBet.
articles.dek: Double Chance covers two of the three results in one bet. "1" is a home win, "X" is a draw and "2" is an away win.
articles.card: Double Chance explained in plain words: what 1X, X2 and 12 cover, when each one wins, and how it compares with a straight win and Draw No Bet.

articles.title: What GG and NG mean in SportyBet (both teams to score)
articles.notice: BetGaffer isn't affiliated with or endorsed by SportyBet.
articles.dek: GG means both teams score at least one goal. NG means at least one team doesn't score.
articles.card: GG and NG explained in plain words: when both teams to score wins, when it loses, and why the winner doesn't matter.

articles.title: What does over 1.5 mean?
articles.dek: Over 1.5 means you're betting on two or more goals in the match, by either team or both together.
articles.card: Over 1.5 goals explained in plain words: how many goals you need, how it settles, and how it compares with over 2.5.

articles.title: What does over 2.5 mean?
articles.dek: Over 2.5 means you're betting on three or more goals in the match, by either team or both together.
articles.card: Over 2.5 goals explained in plain words: how many goals you need, how it settles, and how it differs from under 2.5 and over 1.5.

articles.title: What EarlyGoals means in SportyBet
articles.notice: BetGaffer isn't affiliated with or endorsed by SportyBet.
articles.dek: EarlyGoals is an option on an Over goals bet: if enough goals come early enough, your Over bet is settled as won straight away.
articles.card: EarlyGoals explained in plain words: how many goals by which minute settle your Over bet early, and what happens if they don't come.

articles.title: What 1UP and 2UP mean in SportyBet
articles.notice: BetGaffer isn't affiliated with or endorsed by SportyBet.
articles.dek: 1UP is a win bet that pays early: if your team goes one goal ahead at any point, the bet is settled as won.
